title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience (Independent Contractor)
description:
Overview

Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective’s countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

  • Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)
  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective
  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification
  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil
  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners; provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives
  • Grant making process support (approximately 40%)
  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil
  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos
  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria
  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team
  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation
  • Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)
  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes
  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use
  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced
  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed
  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered
  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills / Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone
  • Ability to commit for six months

Trabalhar na Engemon significa integrar uma empresa com uma história rica, enfrentar uma diversidade de projetos estimulantes, ter oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, fazer parte de uma cultura organizacional que preza pela colaboração, saúde e bem-estar, e contribuir para projetos que geram impactos reais e positivos. title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Program Officer - 25431-FT_LT
description:
WIPO Brazil Office, Regional and National Development Sector

Contract Duration - 2 years (maximum cumulative length of 5 years) *

Application Deadline: 11-Feb-2026, 11:59:00 PM CET

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE : please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant’s location.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

Organizational Context

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO).

The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.

The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.

Purpose Statement

The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil. The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level. The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.

Reporting Lines

The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.

Work Relations

The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.

Duties and Responsibilities

The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:

  • Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.
  • Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.
  • Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.
  • Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.
  • Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.
  • Prepare reports and documents, including performance updated, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.
  • Promote WIPO’s strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO’s Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.
  • Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

Requirements

First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.

Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.

Experience (Essential)

  • At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy.
  • Experience in project design and management.
  • Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.
  • Professional experience in international cooperation programs.
  • Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.

Job Related Competencies (Essential)

  • Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.
  • Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.
  • Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.
  • Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.
  • Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.
  • Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.

Job Related Competencies (Desirable)

  • Good understanding of WIPO’s international registration systems.

  • 2. Showing team spirit.

  • 5. Producing results.
  • 6. Showing service orientation.
  • 7. Seeing the big picture.
  • 8. Seeking change and innovation.
  • 9. Developing yourself and others.

description:
We’re always happy to hear from talented educators who are interested in joining our teaching community at Crimson Global Academy. If you were referred to us or reached out directly, we’d love to learn more about you.

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You’ll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

We’re continuously building our pool of exceptional online teachers across the following curricula:

  • A-Level / IGCSE / IAL (Pearson Edexcel)
  • US Diploma / Advanced Placement
  • Primary and LEAP

This role offers a flexible, fully remote teaching setup, allowing you to create high-quality, personalised learning experiences from home and at a schedule that works for you. You’ll be teaching in a premium one-on-one environment, supported by our full suite of curriculum-aligned resources.

If you’re passionate about student growth and excited by the idea of working with learners from around the world, we invite you to express your interest. Please submit your CV and we’ll be in touch when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student’s unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree in elementary education or a related field
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Ability to dedicate at least 15-20 hours weekly for 6-9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A-Level / AP
    • Key Requirement: Strong knowledge and experience teaching AP or A-Level content.
    • Preferred Qualification: Prior experience preparing students for AP exams.
  • US Diploma (USDP)
    • Key Requirement: Bachelor’s degree with relevant subject credits or solid teaching experience in grades 6–12.
    • Preferred Qualification: Five or more years of classroom teaching in a school setting.
  • Primary
    • Key Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in elementary education or a related field.
    • Preferred Qualification: Experience teaching Grades 3–5 (Forms 4–6).

About Crimson Global Academy

CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students\' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We Are Doing This By

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students\' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now!

Sobre nós

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí! A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)
  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship
  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you\'ll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high-quality results. In this role, you won\'t just review what AI produces — you\'ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world application. Your day-to-day may range from fact-checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human-AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well-reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher-quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines

  • Your level of English is upper-intermediate (B2) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location

Location: Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master\'s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: Quality Commercial Enablement Jr Manager
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).
  • Certifications like Six Sigma / Black Belt or Enablement experience are a plus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Realizar negociações contratuais e comerciais de aquisição de material e contratação de serviços, com o objetivo de promover a melhoria da eficiência operacional e a redução de custos para a MdB.

Contribuir para a melhoria da eficiência operacional e redução de custos da MdB através da monitorização, avaliação e implementação de acções correctivas sobre o desempenho dos prestadores de serviços e materiais contratados.

Assegurar o desenvolvimento e implementação de KPIs adequados, bem como a mentalidade orientada para os resultados de cada Membro do time de Compras, implementando e mantendo uma ampla rotina de gestão baseada em KPIs e PIs.

Assegurar os níveis esperados de desempenho individual e a transparência global da respectiva equipa de Procurement, emitindo, distribuindo e monitorizando relatórios de gestão.

Interface, criar uma forte cooperação e trabalho em rede com as partes interessadas dentro do MODEC.

Contribuir com o Gerenciamento de conflitos, reforçando continuamente a relação de cooperação e interação proativa entre a respectiva Equipe de Procurement da MdB, Equipe MdB SC, Clientes Internos, e restantes Partes Interessadas da MdB.

Na Doctoralia, buscamos um(a) líder com energia, visão estratégica e orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas inbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional.

Descrição da vaga

Na Doctoralia, buscamos um(a) líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas outbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar um time de 4 a 6 SDRs, promovendo desenvolvimento contínuo e foco em alta performance;
  • Garantir a eficiência da operação outbound, desde o lead MQL até a qualificação e agendamento de reuniões;
  • Monitorar indicadores críticos como conversão, tempo de resposta, volume por canal e no-show;
  • Revisar fluxos de cadência, roteiros e abordagens de contato, propondo melhorias com base em dados;
  • Realizar escutas, feedbacks, treinamentos e roleplays com o time;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica com Marketing, Vendas e áreas de suporte para otimizar o funil de qualificação;
  • Propor melhorias de processos e fluxos comerciais, com base em dados e performance do time;
  • Garantir a integração e evolução dos novos SDRs, fortalecendo cultura de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Ser ponte entre o time de pré-vendas e demais áreas, como Marketing, Vendas e Operações;
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Salesforce e Outreach para gestão de performance e automação.

Você vai se conectar com

  • Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta)
  • Executivos de Vendas, Marketing, RevOps e TA
  • Outras lideranças da área comercial

Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com liderança de times SDR ou vendas;
  • Vivência prática liderando times em operações outbound B2B;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com base em dados;
  • Boa comunicação, poder de influência e espírito de colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em CRM e ferramentas de automação (Salesforce, Outreach, etc.);
  • Formação superior completa.

Diferenciais

  • Já ter atuado como SDR antes de assumir a liderança;
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS, tech ou startups;
  • Ter estruturado processos de pré-vendas do zero;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Informações adicionais

  • Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa contribuir com o seu melhor.
  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é de segunda à sexta, das 9h às 18h.
  • Banco de horas para folga caso haja necessidade de trabalhar além do horário habitual.
  • Vale-Transporte para deslocamento ao escritório.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação pelo Cartão iFood, no valor mensal de R$708,54.
  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica) e Odontológica (Porto Seguro).
  • Licenças diferenciadas: 10 dias (falecimento de pessoas amadas), 2 dias (perda de Pets), 7 dias (casamento) e 30 dias para o papai + 6 meses para a mamãe em caso de bebê.
  • Acesso a serviços de acompanhamento nutricional, descontos em suplementos e muito mais.
  • Auxílio Creche para mamães e papais.
  • Acesso ao app iFeel para conforto emocional com apoio de IA.
  • Gympass para bem-estar físico.
  • Plano Pet para o cuidado de animais de estimação.
  • Stock Options elegível após 6 meses de casa (carência de 5 anos).
  • Clube de Parcerias com convênios e descontos, incluindo instituições de ensino e bancos.
  • Benefícios Creditas: empréstimo consignado (eligível após 6 meses).
  • Desconto no Cinemark, no app iFood e no Clube iFood.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido (RJ): morando no RJ e região metropolitana, trabalhará alguns dias no escritório no Santo Cristo/RJ e outros dias em home office, conforme acordo com a liderança.

Etapas do processo seletivo

  • Triagem de currículos – análise de perfil com base nos requisitos da vaga e no momento da área.
  • Entrevista com Talent Acquisition (vídeo) – conhecer experiências, habilidades e fit cultural.
  • Avaliação Comportamental – teste rápido para entender o perfil comportamental.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança – alinhamento técnico e de expectativas.

Pour optimiser notre processus de recrutement, nous avons mis en place un test de sélection qui nous aide à identifier les profils correspondant le mieux aux exigences du poste. description:
(Banco de Talentos) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Outbound) - Vaga Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) | Presencial/RJ

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica ( ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de 09h às 18h | Escala: 5x2 (segunda a sexta) com eventuais escalas aos sábados (opcional).

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Visão: Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional. A atuação do Coordenador de Projetos é estratégica para garantir a fluidez entre áreas, a satisfação do cliente e a solidez dos resultados.

Formação e experiência:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Naval ou áreas afins.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Planejar, coordenar e controlar projetos multidisciplinares, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, orçamentos e padrões técnicos.

  • Elaborar e revisar cronogramas, escopos técnicos, propostas comerciais e relatórios gerenciais.

  • Participar da definição de soluções técnicas, interagindo com engenheiros, projetistas e demais áreas envolvidas.

  • Realizar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com o cliente (interno ou externo), acompanhando marcos e atualizações.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, pacote office avançado, etc.).

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos navais, estruturas offshore, integração de sistemas e engenharia multidisciplinar.

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas nacionais e internacionais, regulatórios da indústria naval/offshore.

  • Domínio de elaboração e acompanhamento de cronogramas, matriz de responsabilidades, controle de escopo e custo.

  • Experiência dando reports ao cliente e alta liderança, incluindo análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).

  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, memoriais descritivos, contratos e escopo executivo.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Comunicação clara e estratégica: habilidade para se comunicar com diferentes perfis, inclusive com níveis hierárquicos variados dentro dos clientes.

  • Organização e priorização: capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos e prazos simultâneos.

  • Liderança colaborativa: saber guiar sem impor, ouvindo o time e garantindo fluidez entre áreas técnicas.

  • Perfil mão na massa: autonomia, iniciativa e disposição para assumir responsabilidades e tomar decisões.

  • Postura profissional e empática: condução firme, porém respeitosa, diante de desafios, conflitos ou mudanças de escopo.

Whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or anything else, the world now awaits.

Our Mission: To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

Responsible for executing and overseeing the procurement of goods and services for rig and office operations, ensuring compliance with company policies, cost-effectiveness, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Review incoming purchase requisitions to confirm material requirements for validity and priority.
  • Ensure fixed pricing agreements with suppliers are utilized to maximize cost savings.

  • Regularly review open purchase orders and expedite overdue or outstanding orders with suppliers.
  • Process invoices and assist Accounts Payable with invoice discrepancies.
  • Maintain general knowledge of company supply chain and financial procedures.

  • Resolve procurement-related incidents reported by end users.

  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office programs.

  • Knowledge of Supply Chain, Inventory, and Procurement processes.
  • Knowledge of rig operations.
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced understanding of supply chain processes and supporting tools.
  • Full understanding of logistics and shipping management, commercial considerations, operational imperatives, and global materials sourcing decision-making.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and process optimization.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook and related Office applications.

Desired

  • Accountability.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Integrity and honesty.
  • Mentoring capability.
  • Professionalism in dealings with external parties.

Education And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Supply Chain Management or a related field.

  • Proven history of successful expediting.

Our goal is to ensure that ‘nobody gets hurt' whilst performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment. Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations. Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate and behaving responsibly towards our shared environment. We co-created our Behavioral Framework with our employees, where we identified four key competencies that define our culture and help us to live our values. Our behaviors are embedded in the way we work and support and guide us day to day:

Quem é Você

Somos mentes curiosas que vêm de uma ampla gama de origens, perspectivas e experiências de vida. Estamos comprometidos em criar acesso e oportunidades para todos se desenvolverem e crescerem no seu próprio ritmo. Junte-se a nós para construir uma cultura de inclusão e pertencimento que impacta milhões e capacita todos a defender o progresso humano!

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open‑source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Location

This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one‑on‑one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional Python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands‑on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open‑source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project – even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Você quer desempenhar um papel essencial na construção de um futuro melhor, trabalhando em projetos que possuem impacto na sociedade e no meio ambiente? Então junte-se à nossa equipe e venha construir o futuro na Siemens! Falar em Siemens no Brasil é falar em fazer o que importa para a sociedade. Empresa líder, com mais de 155 anos de atuação no Brasil, a Siemens combina os mundos real e digital em: tecnologia para automação, digitalização industrial, softwares, sistemas de energia, edifícios e indústrias. Ao longo de sua história, a companhia contribuiu ativamente para a construção e para a modernização da infraestrutura brasileira, com um portfólio de soluções inovadoras que capacita seus clientes a acelerarem sua própria transformação digital e a alcançarem maior sustentabilidade.

Quer fazer parte desse time?

Veja nossa oportunidade para Pessoa Engenheira de Vendas – Eletrificação & Automação de Energia (O&G) – Rio de Janeiro .

Se inscreva e compartilhe!

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de negócios e vendas de soluções de eletrificação e automação de energia direcionadas ao setor de Óleo & Gás (plataformas, FPSOs, terminais, plantas de processo e utilities). Responsável por identificar oportunidades, liderar pré-venda técnico-comercial, propor soluções integradas (média/baixa tensão, proteção, automação de subestações, MCCs, geração e distribuição embarcada) e fechar contratos com EPCs, operadoras e integradores na região.
  • Mapear e desenvolver carteira de clientes O&G (operadoras, estaleiros, EPCs, fornecedores de integração).
  • Conduzir propostas técnico-comerciais complexas, RFQs e negociações contratuais adaptadas a requisitos onshore e offshore.
  • Apoiar estudos de viabilidade técnica, especificações para equipamentos em ambientes marítimos, análise de riscos e atendimento a requisitos de certificação (NORSOK, API, IEC, ATEX quando aplicável).
  • Trabalhar com times de engenharia, conformidade, produto e fábrica para garantir soluções certificadas, robustas e entregáveis.
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas, comissionamento remoto/onsite e treinamentos para cliente e comissionadores.
  • Gerenciar pipeline, forecast e KPIs comerciais; propor ações para expansão de mercado no segmento O&G.
  • Participar de licitações, reuniões técnicas com operadoras e eventos do setor.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Eletrotécnica ou similar.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas ou desenvolvimento de negócios para o setor Óleo & Gás (onshore/offshore), preferencialmente com projetos em plataformas, FPSOs, terminais ou plantas industriais.
  • Conhecimento em equipamentos MT/BT, proteções, automação de subestações, MCCs e soluções de geração/distribuição embarcada.
  • Experiência em elaborar especificações e propostas que atendam requisitos de ambientes marítimos (compatibilização com normas e certificações).
  • Habilidade para negociar com EPCs e operadoras; disponibilidade para viagens e embarque.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com licitações e contratos nacionais e internacionais em O&G.
  • Familiaridade com normas NORSOK, API, IEC, NR-37/NR-29 e requisitos de classificação marítima (ABS, DNV, BV).
  • Inglês fluente; espanhol é diferencial.
  • Experiência com soluções digitais para O&G (SCADA, ADMS, condition monitoring, IIoT para ativos críticos).

Local de trabalho e modelo de contratação

Rio de Janeiro (base RJ) — disponibilidade para deslocamentos onshore/offshore e cliente; modelo híbrido.

Equipes diversificadas são equipes melhores! Se todos pensarmos da mesma forma, a inovação dificilmente acontece. Por isso, buscamos talentos de diferentes origens, gêneros, idades, raças, orientações sexuais e pessoas com deficiência. Na Siemens, as oportunidades são para todos.

Todo o processo admissional acontece por meio da plataforma digital Docteka, um ambiente seguro que protege tanto os dados dos candidatos quanto as informações pertinentes à vaga e à empresa. Além disso, ressaltamos que não realizamos cobrança de taxas de quem participa dos nossos processos seletivos e não exigimos a realização de cursos para preenchimento das vagas. Caso queira fazer parte da nossa empresa, faça a sua inscrição pelos canais oficiais.

Venha conosco construir o futuro! Faça parte do nosso time!

Descrição da empresa

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at Follow @abbvie on, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Tik Tok.

Descrição da vaga

A função de Gerente Distrital atuará no mercado de Neurociência com as indicações terapêuticas de Botox® e terá como missão melhorar a experiência do paciente por meio da liderança, adequação e implementação da estratégia da marca junto ao time In Field, causando um impacto notável em suas vidas. Irá atuar em um ambiente matricial e será importante trabalhar antecipando-se às mudanças de mercado. Essa pessoa ainda deve estimular e criar uma cultura de desenvolvimento de talentos na companhia, sendo responsável pelo desenvolvimento de sua equipe e pela construção das competências essenciais para o negócio. A pessoa que ocupará essa função deverá estar sediada no Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Belo Horizonte (BH) ou Brasília (DF).

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Capturar insights do campo para contribuir ativamente na co-criação da estratégia da marca em parceria com equipe de marketing, bem como a posterior tradução dessa estratégia para a execução no campo;
  • Liderar e acompanhar a adaptação da estratégia de marca por território, co-criando o plano de território (TP) com o Gerente de Marca, MSLs e Gerentes de Acesso, suportando a execução do mesmo pelos consultores técnicos de vendas;
  • Monitorar o desempenho e resultados, analisando KPIs de negócio e criando plano de mitigação para correção de rotas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar a análise estratégica do desempenho do negócio e da equipe, reportando de forma estruturada a evolução de resultados de seu distrito;
  • Analisar cenários competitivos de forma constante com o suporte do time de marketing para assegurar a adequação e implementação da estratégia;
  • Identificar os direcionadores de resultados das principais contas e, em parceria com a equipe de Acesso ao Mercado, contribuir no desenvolvimento de soluções. Corresponsável pela implementação dos Planos de Contas;
  • Liderar o negócio em seu distrito, aplicando raciocínio estratégico, uso da tecnologia e aplicação de possíveis melhorias na alocação de recursos monetários e não monetários;
  • Realizar acompanhamento de desempenho e identificar as fortalezas e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de sua equipe, suportando a elaboração e acompanhamento plano de desenvolvimento individual dos consultores.

REQUISITOS:

  • Superior Completo e desejável pós-graduação;
  • Experiência comercial e de gestão de equipes sólida na indústria farmacêutica;
  • Experiencia mercado Non Retail;
  • Atuação prévia com Neurociências será considerado um diferencial;
  • Inglês – Intermediário será considerado um diferencial;
  • Pacote office (Excel e Power point);
  • Possuir CNH categoria B – Ativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

CONHECIMENTOS:

  • Técnica de vendas;
  • Análise mercadológica (potencial de mercado, clientes, competidores, cenário econômico, etc);
  • Sistema de Saúde público e privado;
  • Farmacoeconomia;
  • Processos administrativos, financeiros e gestão de negócios;
  • Fundamentos de finanças;
  • Normas de ética na indústria farmacêutica.

Informações adicionais

A AbbVie é uma empresa de oportunidades igualitárias e está empenhada em operar com integridade, impulsionando a inovação, transformando vidas e servindo a nossa comunidade. Empregador de Igualdade de Oportunidade/Veteranos/Deficientes.

We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and to be certified in many of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

Responsible for managing end-to-end Network implementation projects. This role bridges technical and project management expertise to ensure successful delivery, coordinating between technical teams, GEO project management team, customers, vendors, and other stakeholders to address challenges and achieve project goals.

What You Will Do

  • Acts as the primary contact during the execution of the project

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams and managing customer/vendor relationships
  • Track record of identifying and mitigating project risks
  • Experience in managing project timelines, budgets, and scope, with a focus on successful project delivery
  • In-depth knowledge of Network services and delivery processes
  • Ability to drive projects and liaise with multiple teams and stakeholders

What We Offer

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 languages and cultures. We’re proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we offer options to work from home.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world

Employee Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. Champion Health support is also available

Professional Development: Training platforms including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that align with local market and employment status

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.
